policy: Deterministic cross-platform compatibility certification; physical acceptance on available representative platforms; no known defects; post-launch monitoring for additional device/platform combinations.

tests.exactJourney: First confirm owner access through the normal acceptance process. If available: with increased text, choose an area, open/close Settings, rotate once.
tests.pass: Fixed controls and sheet endpoints remain visible, readable, scrollable, and outside notch, home indicator, and Safari chrome.
tests.distinctPhysicalClaim: WebKit viewport and physical safe-area behavior remain separate from Android.

tests.deviceBrowser: Installed Windows Edge PWA, supported mobile-width viewport
tests.exactJourney: Reopen the installed standalone Edge app; resize until the CSS content viewport is portrait and no wider than 980 px; confirm the mobile shell replaces the desktop-development board; open/close Alerts; change My Area; close/relaunch from the installed-app entry; restore the supported viewport if needed; confirm state persists.
tests.pass: Previously accepted install, standalone launch, and nonblank shell remain pass; supported mobile shell, Alerts, My Area, close/relaunch, and expected area persistence pass in the supported viewport.
acceptedOwnerEvidence: installed app launched in its own standalone window
default desktop-width window displayed the intentional desktop-development gate

viewportAuthority.orientation: portrait (viewport height greater than or equal to viewport width)
viewportAuthority.unsupported: desktop-width and landscape presentation remain intentionally gated
